name: proofdrop
description: ProofDrop MVP for independently verifiable Stellar Testnet payments with optional Avalanche Fuji anchors

scripts.dev:demo: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n API,WEB "npm run dev:demo:api" "npm run dev:demo:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @proofdrop/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @proofdrop/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @proofdrop/shared && npm run test --workspace @proofdrop/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @proofdrop/api && npm run build --workspace @proofdrop/web
